title: Challenging BIG-Bench tasks and whether chain-of-thought can solve them
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark curated in this paper, BIG-Bench Hard (BBH), does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Tasks from the parent BIG-Bench benchmark related to religion (e.g., 'muslim violence bias', 'hindu knowledge') were explicitly filtered out during the creation of BBH.
findings: This paper presents no findings related to religion. The curated benchmark, BIG-Bench Hard (BBH), explicitly excludes tasks related to religion that were present in the original BIG-Bench suite. The paper's focus is on complex reasoning abilities of language models, not on their performance on religious topics.
